topics.label: Introduction to Inflammation Mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture by outlining its focus on integrating known molecular and cellular components to explain the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate Recognition of Pathogens and Damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms and receptor systems by which the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage.

topics.label: Leukocyte Recruitment and Inflammatory Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how activated sentinel cells orchestrate the migration of immune cells into tissues and the broader physiological consequences of that response.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation and Tissue Repair
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the processes through which the body resolves acute inflammation and manages post-inflammatory tissue outcomes.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and announces the subject of the upcoming lecture.
